zh.mvPanel.status.bilibiliBlocked: Bilibili 暂时拒绝直链解析。可以在 MV 设置里打开诊断报告、配置 Bilibili Cookie，或先外部打开。
zh.mvPanel.status.databaseUnread: MV 数据库不可读。先到曲库恢复里修复数据库；修复前可以在 MV 设置里临时绑定本地视频或自定义链接。
zh.mvPanel.status.externalRequired: 当前 MV 需要外部播放。点 MV 设置里的“在外部打开”，或换一个应用内候选。
zh.mvPanel.status.inAppUnavailable: 当前 MV 暂时不能在应用内播放。可以降低最高画质、换来源，或外部打开。
zh.mvPanel.status.localUnsupported: 本地视频格式不支持。请换成 mp4/webm，或用系统播放器外部打开。
zh.mvPanel.status.missingUrl: 缺少可播放地址。请在 MV 设置里重新搜索、手动粘贴链接，或导入本地视频。
zh.mvPanel.status.networkFailed: 网络 MV 请求失败。先检查代理/网络；也可以在 MV 设置里切换 Bilibili/YouTube 来源、降低画质后重试。
zh.mvPanel.status.notFound: 未找到可播放 MV。可以打开 MV 设置手动搜索、粘贴 Bilibili/YouTube 链接，或导入本地视频。
zh.mvPanel.status.temporaryPlayback: 临时 MV 播放中，数据库待修复
zh.mvPanel.status.videoFailed: 视频加载失败。请换一个候选、降低画质，或外部打开；本地视频可换成浏览器支持的 mp4/webm。

zh.mvSettings.error.databaseUnavailable: MV 数据库暂时不可读，请先到曲库恢复里修复数据库。
zh.mvSettings.error.noLocalCandidates: 没有找到本地 MV 候选
zh.mvSettings.error.noNetworkCandidates: 没有找到网络 MV 候选

zh.mvSettings.immersive.autoScaleDescriptio: 根据 MV 宽高自动补偿缩放，尽量避免背景黑边。
zh.mvSettings.immersive.description: 开启后，歌词页使用当前 MV 作为背景。
zh.mvSettings.immersive.dragHint: 也可以在歌词页空白处拖动调整。
zh.mvSettings.immersive.hideLyricsDescripti: 开启后，切到 MV 界面时不显示歌词文本；默认关闭。
zh.mvSettings.immersive.lyricsReadabilityDe: 为沉浸式 MV 上的歌词增加描边和投影。
zh.mvSettings.immersive.overlayHint: 越低越接近原片，越高歌词越清晰。
zh.mvSettings.immersive.title: 沉浸式 MV 背景
zh.mvSettings.immersive.visualHint: 用于调节沉浸式背景观感。
zh.mvSettings.network.autoApplyThresholdDes: 候选达到 {threshold} 以上才会自动应用。
zh.mvSettings.network.autoPreloadDescriptio: 开启后，只要播放歌曲就会尝试提前查找并准备当前歌曲的 MV。
zh.mvSettings.network.diagnosticsReportDesc: 默认关闭；开启后，MV 页面无画面时显示可复制的本机诊断信息。
zh.mvSettings.network.preferHighestViewCoun: 只在匹配度相同且已通过自动应用门槛的候选中优先播放量。
zh.mvSettings.network.titleOnlySearchDescri: 开启后自动搜索只用歌曲名；关闭后使用歌曲名和歌手。
zh.mvSettings.network.replayAudioOnChangeDe: 开启后，手动选择或绑定新的 MV 会重新播放当前歌曲，让新 MV 立即生效。
zh.mvSettings.network.restartAudioOnLoadDes: 开启后，会持续校准 MV 视频时间，不会 seek 或重启音频；歌词同步偏移不会影响 MV。
zh.mvSettings.network.syncModeDescription: 轻微偏差用变速追平，大偏差才跳转视频。
zh.mvSettings.network.title: 网络来源
zh.mvSettings.offset.description: 正数让 MV 画面提前，负数让 MV 画面延后；只记住当前歌曲的 MV。
zh.mvSettings.offset.replayTitle: 重新播放当前歌曲，并按 MV 起播点同步视频
zh.mvSettings.offset.startDescription: 输入视频里的起点秒数，最高 600 秒；这首歌会直接从那里对齐播放。
zh.mvSettings.offset.title: MV 音画校准
zh.mvSettings.search.placeholder: 输入 MV 搜索关键词
zh.mvSettings.search.useCurrentSong: 使用当前歌曲和歌手搜索

en.mvPanel.title: MV
en.mvPanel.diagnostics.title: MV Diagnostics Report
en.mvPanel.status.bilibiliBlocked: Bilibili temporarily blocked direct stream parsing. Enable the MV diagnostics report, add a Bilibili cookie, or open it externally for now.
en.mvPanel.status.databaseUnread: MV database is unreadable. Repair the library database first; until then, bind a local video or custom link in MV Settings.
en.mvPanel.status.externalRequired: This MV requires external playback. Use Open externally in MV Settings, or choose another in-app candidate.
en.mvPanel.status.inAppUnavailable: This MV cannot play in-app right now. Lower the max quality, switch source, or open it externally.
en.mvPanel.status.localUnsupported: Local video format is not supported. Use mp4/webm, or open it with the system player.
en.mvPanel.status.missingUrl: Missing playable URL. Search again in MV Settings, paste a link manually, or import a local video.
en.mvPanel.status.networkFailed: Network MV request failed. Check proxy/network, or switch Bilibili/YouTube source and lower quality in MV Settings before retrying.
en.mvPanel.status.notFound: No playable MV found. Open MV Settings to search manually, paste a Bilibili/YouTube link, or import a local video.
en.mvPanel.status.temporaryPlayback: Temporary MV playing; database still needs repair
en.mvPanel.status.videoFailed: Video failed to load. Try another candidate, lower quality, or open externally; for local videos, use browser-supported mp4/webm.

en.mvSettings.engine.title: MV Engine

en.mvSettings.error.bilibiliBlocked: Bilibili parsing was blocked. Enable the MV diagnostics report, add a Bilibili cookie, or open externally. Original reason: {reason}
en.mvSettings.error.noActiveTrackBinding: No active library track for MV binding
en.mvSettings.error.noActiveTrackMatching: No active library track for MV matching
en.mvSettings.error.noActiveTrackNetworkSea: No active library track for network MV search

en.mvSettings.immersive.autoScaleDescriptio: Automatically compensates for the MV aspect ratio to reduce background black bars.
en.mvSettings.immersive.description: Use the current MV as the lyrics page background.
en.mvSettings.immersive.dragHint: Drag empty space on the lyrics page to fine tune it.
en.mvSettings.immersive.hideLyricsDescripti: When enabled, lyrics text is hidden while the MV view is open. Off by default.
en.mvSettings.immersive.lyricsReadabilityDe: Adds outline and shadow to lyrics over immersive MV.
en.mvSettings.immersive.overlayHint: Lower keeps the MV closer to the original; higher keeps lyrics clearer.
en.mvSettings.immersive.title: Immersive MV background
en.mvSettings.immersive.visualHint: Tune how the immersive background looks.
en.mvSettings.network.autoApplyThresholdDes: Only apply candidates at {threshold} or higher.
en.mvSettings.network.autoPreloadDescriptio: When enabled, playing a song will look up and prepare its MV ahead of time.
en.mvSettings.network.diagnosticsReportDesc: Off by default; when enabled, the MV page shows a copyable local report if no video is visible.
en.mvSettings.network.preferHighestViewCoun: Uses views only to break ties between candidates that already pass the auto-apply threshold.
en.mvSettings.network.titleOnlySearchDescri: When enabled, automatic MV search uses only the song title. Turn it off to search by title and artist.
en.mvSettings.network.replayAudioOnChangeDe: When enabled, manually selecting or binding a new MV replays the current song so the MV applies immediately.
en.mvSettings.network.restartAudioOnLoadDes: When enabled, the MV video time is continuously corrected. Audio is not seeked or restarted, and lyrics sync offsets do not affect the MV.
en.mvSettings.network.syncModeDescription: Small drift is corrected by video speed; large drift seeks the video.
en.mvSettings.network.title: Network Sources
en.mvSettings.offset.description: Positive values advance the MV; negative values delay it. Saved only for this song MV.
en.mvSettings.offset.replayTitle: Replay the current song and sync the video from the MV start point
en.mvSettings.offset.startDescription: Enter the start second in the video, up to 600s. This song aligns from there.
en.mvSettings.offset.title: MV sync calibration
en.mvSettings.search.useCurrentSong: Search with current song and artist
